subject: Org init: API keys, projects, and role matrix for Stellar Retail
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Soto <alex.soto@stellarretail.com>, Tamara Jones <tamara.jones@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Org init: API keys, projects, and role matrix for Stellar Retail

Hi Alex and Tamara —

Thanks again for the kickoff today. Per our conversation, I wanted to outline the initial plan for creating your Stellar Retail tenant, provisioning API keys, and mapping user roles so your devs can start integration next week. Attached is a short checklist and a role-mapping template to make this quick.

High-level steps we’ll take (timeline in parentheses):
- Create org + default project in your chosen region (us-central) — Priya (same day)
- Create service account(s) and generate one initial API key for integration — Naomi (within 24h)
- Invite users and assign roles per the attached template — Marissa & Karthik (48h)
- Walkthrough SSO/SCIM options if you prefer SSO (optional; separate call) — Priya

Requests we need from your side:
1) A list of 2–3 initial users (email, full name, desired role from the template).
2) Confirmation if Stellar will store keys in HashiCorp Vault (we support Vault + AWS Secrets Manager) or if you prefer Redwood-managed secrets for initial testing.
3) Any IP allowlist ranges for ingress to dedicated endpoints.

Security notes:
- The initial API key we provide is for immediate testing and will be time-limited (30d); we’ll walk you through rotation best practices.
- Don’t paste keys into chat/Slack/email — use the vault or the secure portal link we’ll send.

Next steps: please reply with the user list and Vault preference. Naomi will create the service account once we have confirmation. We can schedule a 30-minute validation call after provisioning.

Attachments: org-init-checklist.pdf, role-mapping-template.xlsx

—
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
https://redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Org init: API keys, projects, and role matrix for Stellar Retail

Quick clarifying question: does Redwood support short-lived keys that can be minted via Vault (we’d prefer to manage rotation from our side)? Also, for the service account scope — can we limit it to only embeddings+generation?

Date: 2026-12-05T13:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Org init: API keys, projects, and role matrix for Stellar Retail

Great question — short answers below, plus next actions.

1) Vault integration: yes. We support HCP/Vault for dynamic key rotation via our secrets bridge. Naomi will share the Vault role/docs. If you want Redwood-managed keys initially, we can provision and mark them for rotation in 30 days; you can swap to Vault later.

2) Service account scopes: absolutely — we can scope service accounts at the model-capability level (embeddings only, generation + tools, or full API). Please indicate the exact scope you want in the role matrix — we’ll enforce least privilege.

3) IP allowlist: send ranges and we’ll add them to the tenant network policy.

Proposed action items (please reply inline):
- Confirm: Vault integration now? (yes/no)
- Provide list of initial users + desired role column filled in role-mapping-template.xlsx
- Provide IP allowlist (optional for now)

I’ve created a secure Drive folder with the onboarding assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3D4-org-onboarding

If you prefer, we can do a short provisioning call tomorrow at 10:00 PT — Naomi and Karthik will join.

—
Priya

Hi Alex / Tamara —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Following Priya’s confirmation, I provisioned the org and default project in the us-central region and created a service account scoped to embeddings+generation per your request.

What I did (summary):
- Org: "stellar-retail" created (us-central)
- Project: "integration" created under the org
- Service account: "sr-integration-sa" created and scoped to embeddings+generation
- Initial API key: "redwood_sk_live_******abcd" (masked below) — visible once in the secure portal link I’ll send.

Important: I will not paste the full key in this thread. Instead, I created a one-time secure access URL for the key and uploaded the rotation script (apikey-rotation-script.sh) to the Drive folder. Please use the Vault if you want dynamic short-lived tokens; otherwise you can store the key in your secrets manager.

Attachments uploaded: apikey-rotation-script.sh
Secure key retrieval link (one-time): https://secrets.redwoodinference.com/get/one-time/8f3b2d

Next steps for you:
1) Alex/Tamara: download the key from the secure link and store it in your vault.
2) Provide the final list of users to invite (I can send invites once I have the emails).
3) If you want SSO, reply here and we’ll run the SSO checklist.
